desc: SnapSafe One Gun keypad Vault will easily accommodate one handguns or other valuable items. Features programmable 2 to 4-digit keypad code ensures security for the contents inside; door is spring-loaded and opens immediately for quick access; foam liner safeguards handguns or other valuables; interior light automatically illuminates when opening; selectable audible and visible low battery indicators and pre-drilled for easy mounting. Requires four AAA batteries (not included). Fits 1911 size pistols and 4" revolvers. Includes two keys.
